# Skitter: a cave mite 0.56 m long, a flat brown shell, a dark head with two glowing pale eyes, six splayed
# legs. Comes in packs. Origin: on the floor under its middle. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Shell --base-color 0.5490 0.4627 0.3804 --no-slot
material new Head --base-color 0.3059 0.2941 0.3529 --no-slot
material new Leg --base-color 0.3059 0.2941 0.3529 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.7020 0.7647 0.5725 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Shell --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.21 --location 0 0.04 0.15
scale 1 1.25 0.6
apply --scale
material assign Shell
add mesh cube --name Head --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.240 0.120
scale 0.200 0.140 0.130
apply --scale
material assign Head
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 1 --location -0.055 -0.315 0.150
scale 0.060 0.040 0.060
apply --scale
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 1 --location 0.055 -0.315 0.150
scale 0.060 0.040 0.060
apply --scale
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name Leg0R --size 1 --location -0.240 -0.120 0.060
scale 0.260 0.070 0.070
apply --scale
material assign Leg
set rotation 0 18 -30
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Leg0L --size 1 --location 0.240 -0.120 0.060
scale 0.260 0.070 0.070
apply --scale
material assign Leg
set rotation 0 -18 30
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Leg1R --size 1 --location -0.240 0.000 0.060
scale 0.260 0.070 0.070
apply --scale
material assign Leg
set rotation 0 18 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Leg1L --size 1 --location 0.240 0.000 0.060
scale 0.260 0.070 0.070
apply --scale
material assign Leg
set rotation 0 -18 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Leg2R --size 1 --location -0.240 0.120 0.060
scale 0.260 0.070 0.070
apply --scale
material assign Leg
set rotation 0 18 30
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Leg2L --size 1 --location 0.240 0.120 0.060
scale 0.260 0.070 0.070
apply --scale
material assign Leg
set rotation 0 -18 -30
apply --rotation
select all
shade flat
export skitter.glb
